question: What is the purpose of the command vagrant init? A. It executes a provisioning tool in a running box. B. It starts a Vagrant box. C. It creates a Vagrant configuration file. D. It installs Vagrant on a Linux host. E. It downloads a Vagrant box.

In any of Xen’s global configuration files. C. In its .config file, when the Domain-0 kernel is built. D. In the configuration file /etc/xen/Domain-0.cfg, when Xen starts. E. In its Makefile, when Xen is built.

Which functionality is provided by Vagrant as well as by Docker? (Choose three.) A. Both can share directories from the host file system to a guest. B. Both start system images as virtual machines instead of containers by default.
